summary.text: Joan Fitzgerald is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 46 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Joan Fitzgerald was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and graduated from Greendale High School in 1982, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree in education in 1986 and a master's degree in curriculum and instruction in 1994, both from the University of Wisconsin, Whitewater.
Her career experience includes working as a high school math teacher and tax preparer, and she served as an elected Jefferson County Supervisor from 2019 to 2024.
Fitzgerald was assigned to the Workforce Development Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
